author: sjm41
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000542090

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
D. melanogaster Prm (FBgn0003149, P35415 / P35416)


* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
erroneous propagation

D. melanogaster Prm (Paramyosin) is getting 'Rho-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity' via PTN000542090, for which the sources are O75116 (human Rho-associated protein kinase 2, ROCK2) and Q13464 (human Rho-associated protein kinase 1, ROCK1).
But Prm has no kinase domains and just has a 'myosin tail' (it's characterized as a structural component of invertebrate muscle thick filaments. (e.g. PMID:16020538))

Can you check, and if you agree, block the kinase annotation to Prm?

This previously came up in https://github.com/geneontology/go-annotation/issues/2888
title: PTN000542090 ()

author: marcfeuermann
body: In fact "protein serine/threonine kinase activity" was blocked, but it was not the case for the child term "Rho-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity", which made the first block silent. I've corrected this.
